selectedBlocks.text: باب ما جاء في السهو إذا قام من ركعتي الفريضة

[1166] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك بن أنس عن ابن شهاب عن عبد الرحمن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة رضى الله تعالى عنه أنه قال صلى لنا رسول الله ﷺ ركعتين من بعض الصلوات ثم قام فلم يجلس فقام الناس معه فلما قضى صلاته ونظرنا تسليمه كبر قبل التسليم فسجد سجدتين وهو جالس ثم سلم

[1167] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك عن يحيى بن سعيد عن عبد الرحمن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة رضى الله تعالى عنه أنه قال إن رسول الله ﷺ قام من اثنتين من الظهر لم يجلس بينهما فلما قضى صلاته سجد سجدتين ثم سلم بعد ذلك
باب إذا صلى خمسا
[1168] حدثنا أبو الوليد حدثنا شعبة عن الحكم عن إبراهيم عن علقمة عن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ صلى الظهر خمسا فقيل له أزيد في الصلاة، فقال وما ذاك قال صليت خمسا فسجد سجدتين بعد ما سلم
باب إذا سلم في ركعتين أو في ثلاث فسجد سجدتين مثل سجود الصلاة أو أطول

[1169] حدثنا آدم حدثنا شعبة عن سعد بن إبراهيم عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال صلى بنا النبي ﷺ الظهر أو العصر فسلم، فقال له ذو اليدين الصلاة يا رسول الله أنقصت، فقال النبي ﷺ لأصحابه أحق ما يقول: قالوا نعم فصلى ركعتين أخريين ثم سجد سجدتين قال سعد ورأيت عروة بن الزبير صلى من المغرب ركعتين فسلم وتكلم ثم صلى ما بقى وسجد سجدتين، وقال هكذا فعل النبي ﷺ
باب من لم يتشهد في سجدتي السهو
وسلم أنس والحسن ولم يتشهدا، وقال قتادة لا يتشهد

[1170] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك بن أنس عن أيوب بن أبي تميمة السختياني عن محمد بن سيرين عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ انصرف من اثنتين، فقال له ذو اليدين أقصرت الصلاة أم نسيت يا رسول الله، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: أصدق ذو اليدين، فقال الناس نعم فقام رسول الله ﷺ فصلى اثنتين أخريين ثم سلم ثم كبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع
[1171] حدثنا سليمان بن حرب حدثنا حماد عن سلمة بن علقمة قال: قلت لمحمد في سجدتي السهو تشهد قال ليس في حديث أبي هريرة
باب من يكبر في سجدتي السهو

[1172] حدثنا حفص بن عمر حدثنا يزيد بن إبراهيم عن محمد عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال صلى النبي ﷺ إحدى صلاتي العشي قال محمد وأكثر ظني العصر ركعتين ثم سلم ثم قام إلى خشبة في مقدم المسجد فوضع يده عليها وفيهم أبو بكر وعمر رضى الله تعالى عنهما فهابا أن يكلماه وخرج سرعان الناس فقالوا أقصرت الصلاة ورجل يدعوه النبي ﷺ ذو اليدين، فقال أنسيت أم قصرت، فقال لم أنس ولم تقصر قال بلى قد نسيت فصلى ركعتين ثم سلم ثم كبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع رأسه فكبر ثم وضع رأسه فكبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع رأسه وكبر

[1173] حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا ليث عن ابن شهاب عن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة الأسدي حليف بني عبد المطلب أن رسول الله ﷺ قام في صلاة الظهر وعليه جلوس فلما أتم صلاته سجد سجدتين فكبر في كل سجدة وهو جالس قبل أن يسلم وسجدهما الناس معه مكان ما نسي من الجلوس تابعه بن جريج عن ابن شهاب في التكبير
باب إذا لم يدر كم صلى ثلاثا أو أربعا سجد سجدتين وهو جالس

[1174] حدثنا معاذ بن فضالة حدثنا هشام بن أبي عبد الله الدستوائي عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: إذا نودي بالصلاة أدبر الشيطان وله ضراط حتى لا يسمع الأذان فإذا قضي الأذان أقبل فإذا ثوب بها أدبر فإذا قضي التثويب أقبل حتى يخطر بين المرء ونفسه يقول اذكر كذا وكذا ما لم يكن يذكر حتى يظل الرجل إن يدري كم صلى فإذا لم يدر أحدكم كم صلى ثلاثا أو أربعا فليسجد سجدتين وهو جالس
باب السهو في الفرض والتطوع
وسجد بن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما سجدتين بعد وتره

[1175] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك عن ابن شهاب عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: إن أحدكم إذا قام يصلي جاء الشيطان فلبس عليه حتى لا يدري كم صلى فإذا وجد ذلك أحدكم فليسجد سجدتين وهو جالس
باب إذا كلم وهو يصلي فأشار بيده واستمع

[1176] حدثنا يحيى بن سليمان قال: حدثني ابن وهب قال: أخبرني عمرو عن بكير عن كريب ان ابن عباس والمسور بن مخرمة وعبد الرحمن بن أزهر رضى الله تعالى عنهم أرسلوه إلى عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فقالوا اقرأ عليها السلام منا جميعا وسلها عن الركعتين بعد صلاة العصر وقل لها إنا أخبرنا أنك تصلينهما وقد بلغنا أن النبي ﷺ نهى عنها، وقال ابن عباس وكنت أضرب الناس مع عمر بن الخطاب عنها، فقال كريب فدخلت على عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فبلغتها ما أرسلوني فقالت سل أم سلمة فخرجت إليهم فأخبرتهم بقولها فردوني إلى أم سلمة بمثل ما أرسلوني به إلى عائشة فقالت أم سلمة رضى الله تعالى عنها سمعت النبي ﷺ ينهى عنها ثم رأيته يصليهما حين صلى العصر ثم دخل وعندي نسوة من بني حرام من الأنصار فأرسلت إليه الجارية فقلت: قومي بجنبه قولي له تقول لك أم سلمة يا رسول الله سمعتك تنهى عن هاتين وأراك تصليهما فإن أشار بيده فاستأخري عنه ففعلت الجارية فأشار بيده فاستأخرت عنه فلما انصرف قال: يا بنت أبي أمية سألت عن الركعتين بعد العصر وإنه أتاني ناس من عبد القيس فشغلوني عن الركعتين اللتين بعد الظهر فهما هاتان
باب الإشارة في الصلاة
قاله كريب عن أم سلمة رضى الله تعالى عنها عن النبي ﷺ

[1177] حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا يعقوب بن عبد الرحمن عن أبي حازم عن سهل بن سعد الساعدي رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ بلغه أن بني عمرو بن عوف كان بينهم شيء فخرج رسول الله ﷺ يصلح بينهم في أناس معه فحبس رسول الله ﷺ وحانت الصلاة فجاء بلال إلى أبي بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه، فقال: يا أبا بكر إن رسول الله ﷺ قد حبس وقد حانت الصلاة فهل لك أن تؤم الناس قال: نعم إن شئت فأقام بلال وتقدم أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فكبر للناس وجاء رسول الله ﷺ يمشي في الصفوف حتى قام في الصف فأخذ الناس في التصفيق وكان أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه لا يلتفت في صلاته فلما أكثر الناس التفت فإذا رسول الله ﷺ فأشار إليه رسول الله ﷺ يأمره أن يصلي فرفع أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه يديه فحمد الله ورجع القهقرى وراءه حتى قام في الصف فتقدم رسول الله ﷺ فصلى للناس فلما فرغ أقبل على الناس، فقال: يا أيها الناس ما لكم حين نابكم شيء في الصلاة أخذتم في التصفيق إنما التصفيق للنساء من نابه شيء في صلاته فليقل سبحان الله فإنه لا يسمعه أحد حين يقول سبحان الله إلا التفت يا أبا بكر ما منعك أن تصلي للناس حين أشرت إليك، فقال أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه ما كان ينبغي لابن أبي قحافة أن يصلي بين يدي رسول الله ﷺ

[1178] حدثنا يحيى بن سليمان قال: حدثني ابن وهب حدثنا الثوري عن هشام عن فاطمة عن أسماء قالت دخلت علي عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها وهي تصلي قائمة والناس قيام فقلت: ما شأن الناس فأشارت برأسها إلى السماء فقلت: آية فقالت برأسها أي نعم

[1179] حدثنا إسماعيل قال: حدثني مالك عن هشام عن أبيه عن عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها زوج النبي ﷺ أنها قالت صلى رسول الله ﷺ في بيته وهو شاك جالسا وصلى وراءه قوم قياما فأشار إليهم أن اجلسوا فلما انصرف قال إنما جعل الإمام ليؤتم به فإذا ركع فاركعوا وإذا رفع فارفعوا

segments.arabic: [1166] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك بن أنس عن ابن شهاب عن عبد الرحمن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة رضى الله تعالى عنه أنه قال
segments.english: ‘Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us. Malik ibn Anas informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from ‘Abd al-Rahman al-A‘raj, from ‘Abdullah ibn Buhaynah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: صلى لنا رسول الله ﷺ ركعتين من بعض الصلوات ثم قام فلم يجلس فقام الناس معه فلما قضى صلاته ونظرنا تسليمه كبر قبل التسليم فسجد سجدتين وهو جالس ثم سلم
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, led us in two rak‘ahs of one of the prayers. Then he stood up without sitting, and the people stood up with him. When he had completed his prayer and we were waiting for his greeting of peace, he pronounced the takbir before the greeting of peace and made two prostrations while seated. Then he gave the greeting of peace.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Buhaina :

Allah's Apostle once led us in a prayer and offered two Rakat and got up (for the third Raka) without sitting (after the second Raka). The people also got up with him, and when he was about to finish his prayer, we waited for him to finish the prayer with Taslim but he said Takbir before Taslim and performed two prostrations while sitting and then finished the prayer with Taslim.
comparisons.note: The third rakah and the second-rakah sitting are supplied in explanatory parentheses; the selected report itself does not name those added positions.

notes: Preserve the full chain, one of the prayers qualification, expectation of the taslim and both sitting prostrations before the final taslim.

Retain the full Malik ibn Anas / Ibn Shihab / al-Araj chain, one of the prayers, the people rising with him, expectation of the greeting and both prostrations before it. No third-rakah explanation is inserted.

segments.arabic: [1167] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك عن يحيى بن سعيد عن عبد الرحمن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة رضى الله تعالى عنه أنه قال

segments.arabic: إن رسول الله ﷺ قام من اثنتين من الظهر لم يجلس بينهما فلما قضى صلاته سجد سجدتين ثم سلم بعد ذلك
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stood up after two rak‘ahs of Dhuhr without sitting between them. When he had completed his prayer, he made two prostrations, then gave the greeting of peace after that.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Buhaina :

Allah's Apostle got up after the second Raka of the Zuhr prayer without sitting in between (the second and the third Rakat). When he finished the prayer he performed two prostrations (of Sahu) and then finished the prayer with Tasllm.
comparisons.note: The second/third-rakah explanation and of Sahu are editorial additions; Tasllm is a transcription defect.

segments.arabic: [1168] حدثنا أبو الوليد حدثنا شعبة عن الحكم عن إبراهيم عن علقمة عن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنه
segments.english: Abu al-Walid related to us. Shu‘bah related to us, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from ‘Alqamah, from ‘Abdullah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

segments.arabic: أن رسول الله ﷺ صلى الظهر خمسا فقيل له أزيد في الصلاة، فقال وما ذاك قال صليت خمسا فسجد سجدتين بعد ما سلم
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, prayed Dhuhr as five rak‘ahs. He was asked, “Has the prayer been increased?” He said, “What is that?” The reply was, “You prayed five.” So he made two prostrations after he had given the greeting of peace.

segments.arabic: [1169] حدثنا آدم حدثنا شعبة عن سعد بن إبراهيم عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال
segments.english: Adam related to us. Shu‘bah related to us, from Sa‘d ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: صلى بنا النبي ﷺ الظهر أو العصر فسلم، فقال له ذو اليدين الصلاة يا رسول الله أنقصت، فقال النبي ﷺ لأصحابه أحق ما يقول: قالوا نعم فصلى ركعتين أخريين ثم سجد سجدتين
segments.english: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, led us in Dhuhr or ‘Asr and gave the greeting of peace. Dhu al-Yadayn said to him, “The prayer, O Messenger of Allah—has it been shortened?” The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said to his companions, “Is what he says true?” They said, “Yes.” So he prayed two more rak‘ahs, then made two prostrations.

segments.arabic: قال سعد ورأيت عروة بن الزبير صلى من المغرب ركعتين فسلم وتكلم ثم صلى ما بقى وسجد سجدتين، وقال هكذا فعل النبي ﷺ
segments.english: Sa‘d said: I saw ‘Urwah ibn al-Zubayr pray two rak‘ahs of Maghrib, give the greeting of peace and speak. Then he prayed what remained and made two prostrations. He said, “This is what the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, did.”

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet led us in the 'Asr or the Zuhr prayer and finished it with Taslim. Dhul-Yadain said to him, "O Allah's Apostle! Has the prayer been reduced?" The Prophet asked his companions in the affirmative. So Allah's Apostle I offered two more Rakat and then performed two prostrations (of Sahu). Sad said, "I saw that 'Ursa bin Az-Zubair had offered two Rakat in the Maghrib prayer and finished it with Taslim. He then talked (and when he was informed about it) he completed the rest of his prayer and performed two prostrations, and said, 'The Prophet prayed like this.' "
comparisons.damagedExcerpt: asked his companions in the affirmative

segments.arabic: [1170] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك بن أنس عن أيوب بن أبي تميمة السختياني عن محمد بن سيرين عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه
segments.english: ‘Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us. Malik ibn Anas informed us, from Ayyub ibn Abi Tamimah al-Sakhtiyani, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

segments.arabic: أن رسول الله ﷺ انصرف من اثنتين، فقال له ذو اليدين أقصرت الصلاة أم نسيت يا رسول الله، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: أصدق ذو اليدين، فقال الناس نعم فقام رسول الله ﷺ فصلى اثنتين أخريين ثم سلم ثم كبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, ended after two rak‘ahs. Dhu al-Yadayn said to him, “Has the prayer been shortened, or did you forget, O Messenger of Allah?” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Has Dhu al-Yadayn spoken the truth?” The people said, “Yes.” So the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stood up and prayed two more rak‘ahs, then gave the greeting of peace. Then he pronounced the takbir and prostrated as he usually prostrated, or longer, then rose.

comparisons.note: The comparison adds a little to the alternative longer prostration; the selected Arabic gives no degree. Preserve its singular prostration episode and exact ending.

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira.

Once Allah's Apostle offered two Rakat and finished his prayer. So Dhul-Yadain asked him, "Has the prayer been reduced or have you forgotten?" Allah's Apostle said, "Has DhulYadain spoken the truth?" The people replied in the affirmative. Then Allah's Apostle stood up and offered the remaining two Rakat and performed Taslim, and then said Takbir and performed two prostrations like his usual prostrations, or a bit longer, and then got up.
comparisons.note: The comparison says two prostrations where the selected Arabic describes a prostration and then rising. It adds remaining and a bit; the selected ending must not be completed from a parallel report.

notes: Keep the singular prostration episode and the final rising exactly as this occurrence ends. Do not append a second episode from 1172 or the English comparison.

segments.arabic: [1172] حدثنا حفص بن عمر حدثنا يزيد بن إبراهيم عن محمد عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال
segments.english: Hafs ibn ‘Umar related to us. Yazid ibn Ibrahim related to us, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: صلى النبي ﷺ إحدى صلاتي العشي قال محمد وأكثر ظني العصر ركعتين ثم سلم
segments.english: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, prayed one of the two afternoon prayers—Muhammad said: I think it was most likely ‘Asr—as two rak‘ahs, then gave the greeting of peace.

segments.arabic: ثم قام إلى خشبة في مقدم المسجد فوضع يده عليها وفيهم أبو بكر وعمر رضى الله تعالى عنهما فهابا أن يكلماه وخرج سرعان الناس فقالوا أقصرت الصلاة ورجل يدعوه النبي ﷺ ذو اليدين، فقال أنسيت أم قصرت، فقال لم أنس ولم تقصر قال بلى قد نسيت
segments.english: Then he stood up and went to a piece of wood at the front of the mosque and placed his hand on it. Abu Bakr and ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, were among them, but they were too awed to speak to him. Those who were hurrying left and said, “Has the prayer been shortened?” A man whom the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, called Dhu al-Yadayn said, “Did you forget, or has it been shortened?” He said, “I did not forget, and it has not been shortened.” He said, “Yes, you have forgotten.”

segments.arabic: فصلى ركعتين ثم سلم ثم كبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع رأسه فكبر ثم وضع رأسه فكبر فسجد مثل سجوده أو أطول ثم رفع رأسه وكبر
segments.english: So he prayed two rak‘ahs, then gave the greeting of peace. Then he pronounced the takbir and prostrated as he usually prostrated, or longer. Then he raised his head and pronounced the takbir. Then he lowered his head and pronounced the takbir and prostrated as he usually prostrated, or longer. Then he raised his head and pronounced the takbir.

comparisons.note: The comparison supplies Asr or Isha as the two named alternatives. The selected Arabic instead uses one of the two al-ashi prayers and separately preserves Muhammads uncertainty about Asr. Do not insert the supplied Isha alternative.

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet offered one of the evening prayers (the sub-narrator Muhammad said, "I think that it was most probably the 'Asr prayer") and he finished it after offering two Rakat only. He then stood near a price of wood in front of the Mosque and put his hand over it. Abu Bakr and 'Umar were amongst those who were present, but they dared not talk to him about that (because of excessive respect for him), and those who were in a hurry went out. They said, "Has the prayer been reduced?" A man who was called DhulYadain by the Prophet said (to the Prophet), "Has the prayer been reduced or have you forgotten?" He said, "Neither have I forgotten, nor has the prayer been reduced." He said, "Certainly you have forgotten." So the Prophet offered two more Rakat and performed Tashm and then said Takbir and performed a prostration of Sahu like his ordinary prostration or a bit longer and then raised his head and said Takbir and then put his head down and performed a prostration like his ordinary prostration or a bit longer, and then raised his head and said Takbir.
comparisons.note: The body has price of wood and Tashm transcription defects. It omits the takbir explicitly following the second lowering of the head; explanations of excessive respect and Sahu are supplied.

notes: Retain Muhammads explicit uncertainty, one of the two al-ashi prayers, both hand/head actions, all four takbirs in the closing prostration sequence and both longer alternatives.

Keep Muhammad named inside the uncertainty aside, both afternoon prayers as a generic pair without adding Isha, the two rakahs, singular hand, awe, hurrying people and every question and answer. All four takbirs and both longer alternatives in the closing sequence remain. The modern explicit pronoun and Messenger wording are not imported into Arabic.

segments.arabic: [1173] حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا ليث عن ابن شهاب عن الأعرج عن عبد الله بن بحينة الأسدي حليف بني عبد المطلب
segments.english: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id related to us. Al-Layth related to us, from Ibn Shihab, from al-A‘raj, from ‘Abdullah ibn Buhaynah al-Asdi, the ally of Banu ‘Abd al-Muttalib:

segments.arabic: أن رسول الله ﷺ قام في صلاة الظهر وعليه جلوس فلما أتم صلاته سجد سجدتين فكبر في كل سجدة وهو جالس قبل أن يسلم وسجدهما الناس معه مكان ما نسي من الجلوس
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stood up in the Dhuhr prayer when he was due to sit. When he had completed his prayer, he made two prostrations, pronouncing the takbir at each prostration while seated, before giving the greeting of peace. The people made them with him in place of the sitting he had forgotten.

segments.arabic: تابعه بن جريج عن ابن شهاب في التكبير
segments.english: Ibn Jurayj corroborated it, from Ibn Shihab, concerning the takbir.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Buhaina Al-Asdi:

segments.arabic: [1174] حدثنا معاذ بن فضالة حدثنا هشام بن أبي عبد الله الدستوائي عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن أبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:
segments.english: Mu‘adh ibn Fadalah related to us. Hisham ibn Abi ‘Abdullah al-Dastawa’i related to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said:

segments.arabic: إذا نودي بالصلاة أدبر الشيطان وله ضراط حتى لا يسمع الأذان فإذا قضي الأذان أقبل فإذا ثوب بها أدبر فإذا قضي التثويب أقبل حتى يخطر بين المرء ونفسه يقول اذكر كذا وكذا ما لم يكن يذكر حتى يظل الرجل إن يدري كم صلى فإذا لم يدر أحدكم كم صلى ثلاثا أو أربعا فليسجد سجدتين وهو جالس
segments.english: When the call to prayer is made, Satan turns away, passing wind so that he does not hear the adhan. When the adhan has ended, he comes back. When the iqamah is called for it, he turns away. When the iqamah has ended, he comes back, coming between a person and his own self, saying, “Remember such-and-such and such-and-such,” things he had not been remembering, until the man does not know how much he has prayed. If one of you does not know how much he has prayed, three or four, let him make two prostrations while seated.

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Apostle said, "When the call for prayer is made, Satan takes to his heels passing wind so that he may not hear the Adhan and when the call is finished he comes back, and when the Iqama is pronounced, Satan again takes to his heels, and when the Iqama is finished he comes back again and tries to interfere with the person and his thoughts and say, "Remember this and that (which he has not thought of before the prayer)", till the praying person forgets how much he has prayed. If anyone of you does not remember whether he has offered three or four Rakat then he should perform two prostrations of Sahu while sitting.
comparisons.note: Before the prayer and of Sahu are supplied explanations. The quoted instruction lacks its final closing quotation mark.

notes: Preserve every call/return sequence, the complete inner prompt, uncertainty between three and four and the final two seated prostrations.

Keep the complete adhan/iqamah sequence, wind, returns, inner prompt, inability to know how much was prayed, three/four alternative and the final two seated prostrations. No before-the-prayer qualifier is supplied.

segments.arabic: [1176] حدثنا يحيى بن سليمان قال: حدثني ابن وهب قال: أخبرني عمرو عن بكير عن كريب
segments.english: Yahya ibn Sulayman related to us. He said: Ibn Wahb related to me. He said: ‘Amr informed me, from Bukayr, from Kuraib:

segments.arabic: ان ابن عباس والمسور بن مخرمة وعبد الرحمن بن أزهر رضى الله تعالى عنهم أرسلوه إلى عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فقالوا اقرأ عليها السلام منا جميعا وسلها عن الركعتين بعد صلاة العصر وقل لها إنا أخبرنا أنك تصلينهما وقد بلغنا أن النبي ﷺ نهى عنها، وقال ابن عباس وكنت أضرب الناس مع عمر بن الخطاب عنها،
segments.english: Ibn ‘Abbas, al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them, sent him to ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her. They said, “Convey greetings of peace to her from all of us. Ask her about the two rak‘ahs after the ‘Asr prayer, and say to her, ‘We have been informed that you pray them, but it has reached us that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, forbade them.’” Ibn ‘Abbas said, “I used to strike people for them along with ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab.”

segments.arabic: فقال كريب فدخلت على عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فبلغتها ما أرسلوني فقالت سل أم سلمة فخرجت إليهم فأخبرتهم بقولها فردوني إلى أم سلمة بمثل ما أرسلوني به إلى عائشة
segments.english: Kuraib said: I went in to ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, and conveyed what they had sent me with. She said, “Ask Umm Salamah.” So I went out to them and told them what she had said. They sent me back to Umm Salamah with the same message they had sent me with to ‘A’ishah.

segments.arabic: فقالت أم سلمة رضى الله تعالى عنها سمعت النبي ﷺ ينهى عنها ثم رأيته يصليهما حين صلى العصر ثم دخل وعندي نسوة من بني حرام من الأنصار فأرسلت إليه الجارية فقلت: قومي بجنبه قولي له تقول لك أم سلمة يا رسول الله سمعتك تنهى عن هاتين وأراك تصليهما فإن أشار بيده فاستأخري عنه ففعلت الجارية فأشار بيده فاستأخرت عنه
segments.english: Umm Salamah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, said: I heard the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, forbid them. Then I saw him praying them when he had prayed ‘Asr. Then he entered, and I had with me women from Banu Haram of the Ansar. I sent the slave girl to him, saying, “Stand beside him. Say to him, ‘Umm Salamah says to you: O Messenger of Allah, I heard you forbid these two, and I see you praying them.’ If he signals with his hand, draw back from him.” The slave girl did so. He signalled with his hand, and she drew back from him.

segments.arabic: فلما انصرف قال: يا بنت أبي أمية سألت عن الركعتين بعد العصر وإنه أتاني ناس من عبد القيس فشغلوني عن الركعتين اللتين بعد الظهر فهما هاتان
segments.english: When he finished, he said, “O daughter of Abu Umayyah, you asked about the two rak‘ahs after ‘Asr. Some people from ‘Abd al-Qays came to me and occupied me, keeping me from the two rak‘ahs after Dhuhr. These are those two.”

comparisons.note: The messenger is told to wait in the comparison, whereas the selected instruction and response use stepping or drawing back from him. Keep the action distinct from an explanatory rendering.

checkedBody: Narrated Kuraib:

I was sent to Aisha by Ibn Abbas, Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar . They told me to greet her on their behalf and to ask her about the offering of the two Rakat after the 'Asr prayer and to say to her, "We were informed that you offer those two Rakat and we were told that the Prophet had forbidden offering them." Ibn Abbas said, "I along with 'Umar bin Al-Khattab used to beat the people whenever they offered them." I went to Aisha and told her that message. 'Aisha said, "Go and ask Um Salama about them." So I returned and informed them about her statement. They then told me to go to Um Salama with the same question with which t sent me to 'Aisha. Um Salama replied, "I heard the Prophet forbidding them. Later I saw him offering them immediately after he prayed the 'Asr prayer. He then entered my house at a time when some of the Ansari women from the tribe of Bani Haram were sitting with me, so I sent my slave girl to him having said to her, 'Stand beside him and tell him that Um Salama says to you, "O Allah's Apostle! I have heard you forbidding the offering of these (two Rakat after the 'Asr prayer) but I have seen you offering them." If he waves his hand then wait for him.' The slave girl did that. The Prophet beckoned her with his hand and she waited for him. When he had finished the prayer he said, "O daughter of Bani Umaiya! You have asked me about the two Rakat after the 'Asr prayer. The people of the tribe of 'Abdul-Qais came to me and made me busy and I could not offer the two Rakat after the Zuhr prayer. These (two Rakat that I have just prayed) are for those (missed) ones.
comparisons.note: The final address is daughter of Bani Umaiya instead of the selected daughter of Abu Umayyah. Immediately, my house and the waiting interpretation are additions or expansions, and the closing quotation marks are incomplete.

notes: Preserve the complete Kuraib mission, all senders and honorifics, Ibn Abbas statement, both visits, the servant instructions and movements and the final Abu Umayyah / Abd al-Qays explanation.

segments.arabic: [1177] حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا يعقوب بن عبد الرحمن عن أبي حازم عن سهل بن سعد الساعدي رضى الله تعالى عنه
segments.english: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id related to us. Ya‘qub ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman related to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

segments.arabic: أن رسول الله ﷺ بلغه أن بني عمرو بن عوف كان بينهم شيء فخرج رسول الله ﷺ يصلح بينهم في أناس معه فحبس رسول الله ﷺ وحانت الصلاة فجاء بلال إلى أبي بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه، فقال: يا أبا بكر إن رسول الله ﷺ قد حبس وقد حانت الصلاة فهل لك أن تؤم الناس قال: نعم إن شئت
segments.english: It reached the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, that something had happened among Banu ‘Amr ibn ‘Awf. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out with some people to reconcile them. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was delayed, and the time for prayer came. Bilal came to Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, and said, “O Abu Bakr, the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, has been delayed, and the time for prayer has come. Would you lead the people?” He said, “Yes, if you wish.”

segments.arabic: فأقام بلال وتقدم أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فكبر للناس وجاء رسول الله ﷺ يمشي في الصفوف حتى قام في الصف فأخذ الناس في التصفيق وكان أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه لا يلتفت في صلاته فلما أكثر الناس التفت فإذا رسول الله ﷺ فأشار إليه رسول الله ﷺ يأمره أن يصلي فرفع أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه يديه فحمد الله ورجع القهقرى وراءه حتى قام في الصف فتقدم رسول الله ﷺ فصلى للناس
segments.english: Bilal called the iqamah. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, went forward and pronounced the takbir for the people. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came walking through the rows until he stood in the row. The people began clapping. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, did not turn around during his prayer. When the people increased it, he turned, and there was the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, signalled to him, directing him to pray. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, raised his hands and praised Allah, then stepped backwards behind him until he stood in the row. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went forward and led the people in prayer.

segments.arabic: فلما فرغ أقبل على الناس، فقال: يا أيها الناس ما لكم حين نابكم شيء في الصلاة أخذتم في التصفيق إنما التصفيق للنساء من نابه شيء في صلاته فليقل سبحان الله فإنه لا يسمعه أحد حين يقول سبحان الله إلا التفت يا أبا بكر ما منعك أن تصلي للناس حين أشرت إليك،
segments.english: When he finished, he turned towards the people and said, “O people, why, when something happened to you in prayer, did you begin clapping? Clapping is only for women. Whoever has something happen to him in his prayer should say, ‘Glory be to Allah,’ for no one hears him when he says ‘Glory be to Allah’ without turning around. O Abu Bakr, what prevented you from leading the people in prayer when I signalled to you?”

segments.arabic: فقال أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه ما كان ينبغي لابن أبي قحافة أن يصلي بين يدي رسول الله ﷺ
segments.english: Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, said, “It was not fitting for the son of Abu Quhafah to pray in front of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.”

comparisons.note: The selected statement that he went with other people is absent; first is added to the row although it is not in the selected wording.

checkedBody: Narrated Sahl bin Sad As-Sa'idi :

The news about the differences amongst the people of Bani'Amr bin 'Auf reached Allah's Apostle and so he went to them along with some of his companions to affect a reconciliation between them. Allah's Apostle was delayed there, and the time of the prayer was due. Bilal went to Abu Bakr and said to him, "Allah's Apostle has been delayed (there) and the time of prayer is due. So will you lead the people in prayer?" Abu Bakr said, "Yes, if you wish." Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr, went forward and said Takbir for the people. In the mean-time Allah's Apostle came crossing the rows (of the praying people) and stood in the (first) row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr, would never glance side-ways in his prayer but when the people clapped much he looked back and (saw) Allah's Apostle . Allah's Apostle beckoned him to carry on the prayer. Abu Bakr raised his hands and thanked Allah, and retreated till he reached the (first) row. Allah's Apostle went forward and led the people in the prayer. When he completed the prayer he faced the people and said, "O people! Why did you start clapping when something unusual happened to you in the prayer? Clapping is only for women. So whoever amongst you comes across something in the prayer should say, 'Subhan-Allah' for there is none who will not turn round on hearing him saying Subhan-Allah. O Ab-u Bakr! What prevented you from leading the people in the prayer when I beckoned you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "How dare the son of Abu Quhafa lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Apostle ?"
comparisons.note: The comparison adds first to the row and paraphrases the final it was not proper response as a rhetorical how dare question. Preserve the complete source sequence and wording independently.

notes: Keep the full separate Sahl route, companions on the journey, prayer-time sequence, Abu Bakrs takbir, repeated gestures and the complete closing response. Do not substitute another version of this repeated account.

Preserve the complete Sahl route, accompanying people, prayer-time sequence, Abu Bakrs takbir for the people, row without first, raised hands in the plural, every honorific, both Glory be to Allah occurrences and the full final Ibn Abi Quhafah response. No wording is borrowed from 1143 or 1160.

segments.arabic: [1178] حدثنا يحيى بن سليمان قال: حدثني ابن وهب حدثنا الثوري عن هشام عن فاطمة عن أسماء قالت
segments.english: Yahya ibn Sulayman related to us. He said: Ibn Wahb related to me. Al-Thawri related to us, from Hisham, from Fatimah, from Asma’, who said:

segments.arabic: دخلت علي عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها وهي تصلي قائمة والناس قيام فقلت: ما شأن الناس فأشارت برأسها إلى السماء فقلت: آية فقالت برأسها أي نعم
segments.english: I went in to ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, while she was standing in prayer, and the people were standing. I said, “What is the matter with the people?” She gestured with her head towards the sky. I said, “A sign?” She said with her head—that is, “Yes.”

notes: Retain the complete route through al-Thawri, Hisham and Fatimah, both questions and the head gestures. The selected preposition spelling and the historical response wording remain disclosed.

Preserve the selected dotted-ya spelling without editing Arabic. The English follows the context of going in to Aishah; both printed prepositions and the historical response variant remain disclosed. Both questions and the said-with-her-head idiom stay complete.
The selected digital preposition ends in ya with dots, whereas both print excerpts use alif maqsura. Preserve the original even for this orthographic difference.

Historical says she gestured with her head; selected and modern use she said with her head. Preserve the selected expression for independent translation review.

segments.arabic: [1179] حدثنا إسماعيل قال: حدثني مالك عن هشام عن أبيه عن عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها زوج النبي ﷺ أنها قالت
segments.english: Isma‘il related to us. He said: Malik related to me, from Hisham, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who said:

segments.arabic: صلى رسول الله ﷺ في بيته وهو شاك جالسا وصلى وراءه قوم قياما فأشار إليهم أن اجلسوا فلما انصرف قال إنما جعل الإمام ليؤتم به فإذا ركع فاركعوا وإذا رفع فارفعوا
segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, prayed in his house while ill, seated. Some people prayed behind him standing, so he signalled to them to sit down. When he finished, he said, “The imam has only been appointed to be followed. When he bows, bow, and when he rises, rise.”

comparisons.note: The body contains a stray asterisk after Messenger of Allah and an unclosed quotation. Head is made explicit in the final raising instruction although the selected Arabic does not name it.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Aisha the wife of the Prophet:

Allah's Apostle during his illness prayed in his house sitting, whereas some people followed him standing, but the Prophet beckoned them to sit down. On completion of the prayer he said, "The Imam is to be followed. So, bow when he bows, and raise your head when he raises his head." (See Hadith No. 657 Vol 1 for taking the verdict).
comparisons.note: The final parenthetical reference for taking the verdict is an editorial addition, not part of the selected report. Head is made explicit in the raising instruction.

notes: Keep the singular selected reporting verb, illness/seated setting, followers instruction and complete final bowing/raising clauses. The historical print differs in the reporting verb.

Preserve selected related to me, the complete Hisham/from his father chain, Aishahs wife attribution and both Prophetic honorifics, the illness and seated setting, followers instruction and bowing/rising clauses. No head noun, verdict pointer or historical related to us is inserted.
